name: Paclitaxel + Trastuzumab (APT)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: HER2-directed de-escalated adjuvant regimen: requires HER2-positive disease (IHC 3+ or ISH-amplified). Intended for low-risk small node-negative tumors (T1, N0, M0), particularly patients not eligible for other standard adjuvant regimens due to comorbidities. HR (ER/PR) status tested to guide endocrine therapy. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer, BINV-M 4 of 10 footnote m and BINV-M 7 of 10 (APT / Tolaney).

histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) and invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC))

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid, H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling to prevent hypersensitivity.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: weekly paclitaxel is low emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
Cardiac: evaluate LVEF before and during trastuzumab (every 3 months per FDA label / BINV-M 1 of 10). Trastuzumab continues to complete 1 year after the 12 weeks of paclitaxel.
monitoring: LVEF at baseline and periodically during trastuzumab (every 3 months per FDA label / BINV-M 1 of 10)

doseModificationRules.condition: significant decline in LVEF or symptomatic heart failure
doseModificationRules.text: Hold trastuzumab and obtain clinical review per LVEF monitoring guidance (BINV-M 1 of 10).

drugs.name: PACLitaxel
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. PACLitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV weekly for 12 weeks (weekly, cycle length 7 days). Tall-man per ISMP.

drugs.name: Trastuzumab (loading dose)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. Trastuzumab 4 mg/kg IV loading dose, given with the first dose of paclitaxel.

drugs.name: Trastuzumab (weekly maintenance)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. Trastuzumab 2 mg/kg IV weekly to complete 1 year of treatment. Alternative (source-stated): trastuzumab 6 mg/kg IV every 21 days following completion of paclitaxel, to complete 1 year of trastuzumab therapy.
